title: the Correlation Between Non-invasive Indicators in Patients With Biliary Atresia
brief_summary: we propose this study and try to find out possible clinical applicable non-invasive imaging indices or its combination with the laboratory indices to predict the status of hepatic fibrosis in BA patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pathological proved diagnosis of biliary atresia, and without other distinct abnormality or malformations. All had undergone Kasai portoenterostomy. All of them received abdominal MRI study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* absence of laboratory data required.
condition: to Find Out Non-invasive Indices to Predict the Status of Hepatic Fibrosis in BA Patients.
